method.rule: Only visually inspected success outputs may receive a verdict; API success alone is not a visual pass.
method.alpha: Read-only pixel checks where relevant. Appearance alone cannot verify alpha.
method.comparison: new_win,old_win,tie,unresolved; ties can include equally failed outputs
method.productionEvidence: Generated proposals are not proof of physical samples, dimensions, tooling, embroidery files or textile construction.
method.twoStrike: Repeated fundamental failures are REJECTED and diagnosed, never used as a new reference.
